knobs.dead_default: `%(file)s` defines `%(name)s` but **never uses it** — a declared default that has no effect is worse than none (it makes people think it is configured)
knobs.declared_not_read: `%(file)s` declares it consumes %(knobs)s but the source never reads those knobs — declaration disagrees with implementation (the AUTO:GATES table would lie)
knobs.module_only: knobs is a module (consumed by the gates); run --selftest for its self-test.
knobs.pack_extra_keys: pack %(lang)s has keys absent from %(reference)s (the other side then shows bare codes): %(keys)s
knobs.pack_missing_code: the core emits codes that are absent from the %(lang)s pack (%(count)d of them) — users on that language would see bare codes: %(codes)s
knobs.pack_missing_keys: pack %(lang)s is missing keys present in %(reference)s (users on %(lang)s would see bare codes): %(keys)s
knobs.pack_placeholder_mismatch: pack %(lang)s's `%(key)s` placeholder names differ from %(reference_lang)s (%(reference_lang)s: %(expected_params)s / %(lang)s: %(actual_params)s) — rendering would KeyError
knobs.pack_sync_empty: the language-pack directory holds no pack at all (%(pack_dir)s) — if REFLECT_I18N is set it must point at a directory that actually has packs: install one, or unset the knob (unsetting means: use the packs that ship with the toolkit)
knobs.pack_unreadable: pack %(lang)s could not be read (%(error)s) — a broken pack must not be skipped as if uninstalled
knobs.phantom_token: token `%(token)s` appears in zreflect/*.py but is not in the knob registry — either a typo (silently ignored by every program) or a phantom knob (promised in docs, never read by code). Only a registration counts
knobs.readme_missing_rows: %(file)s config table lacks rows for these registered knobs: %(knobs)s — registered but nobody knows how to configure them (documentation gap)
knobs.readme_phantom: %(file)s mentions unregistered knob `%(token)s` — phantom or typo; register it in zreflect/knobs.py
knobs.sem.reflect_ab: spec name for the A/B same-flags gate
knobs.sem.reflect_doc: living-state document (machine blocks render into it)
knobs.sem.reflect_docs: living-state documents scanned by the retraction / staleness gates
knobs.sem.reflect_doctor: doctor spec (start-of-work preflight, not a gate)
knobs.sem.reflect_env_file: filename of the hook knob carrier
knobs.sem.reflect_env_hint: off ⇒ disables the friendly hint suggesting Einfacht.env on a bare run (the hint is not a criterion)
knobs.sem.reflect_i18n: language pack directory (defaults to zreflect/lang shipped with the suite)
knobs.sem.reflect_i18n_root: extra source dir scanned by the language-coverage gate (repo-relative); empty = scan only the suite's own zreflect/ + reflect-hooks/, never the adopter's code
knobs.sem.reflect_instrument_days: constancy-detection threshold in days; empty = that rule is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_instruments: measurement-method registry slot; empty = that rule is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_invariants: declarative invariants spec; empty = explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_lang: output language pack name (e.g. zh/en); empty = null pack (the core speaks no language)
knobs.sem.reflect_locks: spec name for the locked-sources gate
knobs.sem.reflect_measure_module: collector module name (re-homing a repo changes one env line; empty = the placeholder measure_example)
knobs.sem.reflect_naked_min: bare-number threshold (integer literals below it are not checked)
knobs.sem.reflect_no_principles: set to 1 ⇒ this repo does **not** register the principles into the ledger (no per-commit replay); this is the explicit opt-out, do not rely on deleting PRINCIPLES.md
knobs.sem.reflect_phases: extra custom phases (comma separated, e.g. lab); built-in commit/start-of-work cannot be removed or duplicated
knobs.sem.reflect_pins: spec name for the derived-tree pin consistency gate
knobs.sem.reflect_readmes: the trilingual README list (cross-linked structure + same batch on every push)
knobs.sem.reflect_replay: off ⇒ the replay gate is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_replay_timeout: default timeout in seconds for the verbatim executor
knobs.sem.reflect_retired: list of retired component names; empty = that rule is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_stale_days: measurement-age alarm in days; empty = that rule is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_world: world declaration (list of things to verify); missing file = off
knobs.sem.reflect_world_line: world line override (CI / special run modes)
knobs.usage: usage: knobs.py [--list|--selftest] (--list = every REFLECT_* knob: kind / default / meaning)
knobs.sem.reflect_snapshot_root: source dir scanned by the snapshot gate; empty = scan only the suite's own zreflect/ (name your dir to audit your own code)
